  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

  discount_pct NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL  -- Percentage discount, 0-100. Line revenue is quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct / 100).

  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
  payment_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  payment_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
  payment_method VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  transaction_ref VARCHAR(100)
);

CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  product_name VARCHAR(250) NOT NULL,

  category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  supplier_id INTEGER,

  unit_cost NUMERIC(12,2)  -- Cost to acquire the product. Revenue minus cost gives margin.,
  weight_kg NUMERIC(10,3),

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE shipments (
  shipment_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shipped_date TIMESTAMPTZ,

CREATE TABLE order_items (
